risk.label: Risk

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.explain: A score from 0 to 100 showing how ready the bank is for an audit today: reports filed on time, rules approved and alerts reviewed.

badge.verifiedHint: This answer used a query that the compliance team has checked and approved. The numbers come straight from the data.

evidence.untouchedHint: The file's fingerprint (SHA-256) matches the one recorded when it was created.
